rpg.europa.ability.charge.desc: Dash forward and strike everything ahead.
rpg.europa.ability.blood_rage.desc: Strength II, Speed II, Haste II and Regeneration for 10 s.
rpg.europa.ability.divine_shield.desc: Heals and shields nearby allies; burns the undead.
rpg.europa.ability.arcane_missile.desc: Instant magic bolt at your target.

rpg.europa.ability.smoke_bomb.desc: Blinds nearby enemies; you turn invisible and fast.
rpg.europa.ability.piercing_shot.desc: Pierces every enemy in a line (64 blocks).
rpg.europa.ability.restoring_light.desc: Heals you and nearby allies and removes poison, wither and weakness.
rpg.europa.ability.sanctuary.desc: Consecrates the area for 10 s: heals allies and burns undead every second.
rpg.europa.ability.judgment.desc: Holy lightning on the target; double damage to undead.
rpg.europa.ability.raise_servant.desc: Raises an undead servant for 45 s (max 2).
rpg.europa.ability.blood_pact.desc: Damages all within 6 blocks and heals half the damage dealt.

rpg.europa.class.paladin.desc: Holy warrior combining defense, combat and divine power.
rpg.europa.class.monk.desc: Body techniques, discipline and inner energy.

rpg.europa.class.crossbowman.desc: Crossbows and technical shots; uses slowly recharging Charges.
rpg.europa.class.arcane_gunner.desc: Enchanted projectile weapons and magic ammunition.

rpg.europa.class.druid.desc: Commands nature and reshapes its own body.
rpg.europa.class.necromancer.desc: Spirit energies and the undead; gains Spirit on kills.
rpg.europa.class.bard.desc: Music and enchantments that shape combat.
rpg.europa.class.war_arcanist.desc: Weaves weapons and spells in the same fight.

rpg.europa.subclass.weapon_master.desc: Mastery of many weapons and techniques.
rpg.europa.subclass.furious.desc: More power the longer the fight goes.
rpg.europa.subclass.shadow_master.desc: Appears behind the foe and blinds it.
rpg.europa.subclass.assassin.desc: Eliminates single targets with lethal strikes.
rpg.europa.subclass.challenger.desc: Challenges a foe to a duel.
rpg.europa.subclass.elementalist.desc: Combines fire and frost in areas.
rpg.europa.subclass.black_well.desc: A rift that consumes and returns energy.
rpg.europa.subclass.collapse.desc: Pulls and crushes foes into one point.
rpg.europa.subclass.shapeshifter.desc: Takes the form of a beast.
rpg.europa.subclass.demonic_pact.desc: Hellfire at the cost of one's own life.
rpg.europa.subclass.war_herald.desc: Anthems that drive the party to victory.
rpg.europa.subclass.arcane_smith.desc: Tempers and repairs weapons in combat.
rpg.europa.subclass.elemental_sword.desc: Fire and frost on the blade.
